scope: Complete preregistered retrieval sample: E1-long, E2-short and E3-long; all three requested groups and all 18 anonymous candidates reviewed.

blinding.representation_limit: Candidate evidence representations can be inferred from available_evidence; labels remain anonymous. This is not a claim of perfect treatment blinding.
blinding.authorship: Reviewer authored separate rental fixtures, not retrieval fixtures. Reviewer previously performed a pre-run read-only structure/feasibility check of retrieval fixtures; the present outcome review uses only the authorized anonymous packet.

method: Read complete source reference/gold and all six response objects, then compare support with each candidate’s actual available_evidence.
Evaluate substance across prose, findings, limitations, next steps and scalar facts; noncontradictory fact rows can communicate a required count, but cannot excuse contradictory prose.

Distinguish missing available findings, justified limited-evidence uncertainty, unsupported factual assertions, wrong decisions and exact-quote defects. Equivalent justified next steps and semantically equivalent statuses are acceptable.
Do not require one preferred excerpt where an alternative exact supplied excerpt supports the same fact.
No benchmark CLI/API/model calls, external requests, frozen-source edits or commits were made. Current parent/subagent review reasoning is outside measured CLI totals.
